subject: NorthGrove implementation orbit: action book & governance cadence
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@northgrove.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: ops@northgrove.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + go-live windows (NorthGrove)

Jonas — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Ops leadership asked me to sketch out a practical MAP so we can align on responsibilities and a realistic go-live window. I attached a quick spreadsheet with suggested milestones.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm lead owners for integration, infra, and training.
- Target go-live week (we're aiming for the first full week of Feb).
- List any gating items (SOC2 evidence, network allowlists, data retention policy) and owners.

Can your team review and propose owners by EOD Monday? Would like to set a twice-weekly 30m cadence for the next 8 weeks to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Director, Platform Integrations
NorthGrove Health

Attachment: NorthGrove_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet - proposed milestones)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@northgrove.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T11:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + go-live windows (NorthGrove)

Elena — really appreciate the clear starters in the sheet. Looping in Marissa (CS lead for NorthGrove) and Ben (implementation lead) so we can assign owners and call out dependencies.

Quick responses inline: 
- Target go-live: first week of Feb looks feasible. We'll validate capacity and any training slots.
- Cadence: 30m twice-weekly works; propose Tue/Thu 10:00-10:30 PT starting 2026-11-24.
- Gating items we see so far: SOC2 evidence (security), network allowlist (infra), and feature acceptance tests (CS/training).

Ben / Marissa — can you take the sheet and populate "Redwood owner" column + an ETA for the gating items by EOD Monday (2026-11-23)? Also flag anything that would push the go-live past Feb wk1.

Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Success Ops | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@northgrove.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + go-live windows (NorthGrove)

Thanks Jonas — I pulled the sheet and added granular owners and dates in the attached PDF (implementation-milestones.pdf). Summary below so Elena has a quick view: 

Milestone summary (owners | target):
- Integration kickoff & sample data exchange (Ben Carter | 2026-11-29)
- SOC2 evidence intake (Security Ops: Ben/supported by Customer Security | 2026-12-06)
- Network allowlist & test endpoint (Infra: ben.carter+infra | 2026-12-03)
- First training cohort (CS: Marissa Cole | 2027-01-09)
- Acceptance testing (Joint QA: Marissa + NorthGrove QA | 2027-01-23)
- Staged cutover & monitoring plan (CS + Infra | 2027-01-30)
- Go-live week (production traffic ramp) (Deployment | 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-05)

Risks & notes:
- SOC2 intake may require a follow-up evidence packet; Ben will coordinate directly with Elena's security team.
- If training cannot start by 2027-01-09 we should move acceptance/testing and push the go-live one week.

Action items assigned to Redwood:
- Ben: complete sample data exchange and send test harness by 2026-11-29 (Attachment: test-harness.zip referenced).
- Marissa: share training materials and schedule first cohort invites by 2026-12-15.
- Jonas: set up recurring Tue/Thu 10:00-10:30 PT with meeting notes + agenda.

Elena — confirming the cadence and owners above. If that looks good, Ben will open a ticket thread with your security contact for SOC2 pieces.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: implementation-milestones.pdf (PDF - owners & dates)
Referenced: test-harness.zip (attachment to be uploaded to drive)
